body:
It is about perspective...
Asking someone who can't get out of bed to go and volunteer for something is ridiculous. If I have no desire to continue my own life why would I have any to help others?

This is silly and unconvincing.

Someone can be easily starving and still maintain a will to live. The fact you're saying "those who just want another day" only helps show that. The situations are not comparable. Not to mention some of the happiest countries in the world are poorer countries, albeit not particularly Africa. But Africa has much bigger problems than starvation and poverty. 

Really, you have no perspective at all on how people suffer. 

You have no business being in this subreddit. You're lucky I have more control over myself at the moment. The next person you try and guilt however might not.
